name: patch-lang
description: Patch: a tiny change-oriented programming language with semantic change contracts, Lean-checked range/source evidence, and a first direct Change IR to WebAssembly execution backend

scripts.build:example: node src/cli.js build examples/score.patch --kind console --target portable --out Score.patchapp
scripts.build:wasm: node src/cli.js build examples/score.patch --kind console --target wasm --out Score.wasm
scripts.build:wasm-direct: node src/cli.js build examples/score.patch --kind console --target wasm-direct --out Score.direct.wasm
